source_clauses.verbatim: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp is attached to the desk edge and holds the monitor arm.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp fits desk edges with thickness between 18 and 40 mm.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
requirements.observable_verbatim: When loaded, the clamp does not slip or rotate relative to the desk edge.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp can be removed and reattached without using tools.

scenarios.name: desk edge clamping
scenarios.system_boundary: The clamp is inside; the desk edge and the monitor arm are outside.

scenarios.name: clamp removal and relocation
scenarios.system_boundary: The clamp is inside; the desk and the monitor arm are outside.

freedoms.decision: mechanism and materials for the clamp
freedoms.why_free: The text does not specify how the clamp achieves its function.

freedoms.decision: weight or mass of the monitor arm
freedoms.why_free: The text does not state a specific weight.

ambiguities.statement: The phrase 'without any tools' does not specify whether the clamp must be adjustable or whether it can be tightened by hand.

assumptions.statement: The monitor arm is a separate item that attaches to the clamp.
assumptions.why: The request says 'fixes a monitor arm' but does not define the arm.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the monitor arm is integrated into the clamp.
